headline: Vonni said to the FBI ‘he’s like a candle on the cake, ain’t a birthday without the candle
body: Source commentary: Vonni said to the FBI ‘he’s like a candle on the cake, ain’t a birthday without the candle’. And that he was gonna make a Vice documentary on his life. These are source claims, not findings of guilt.
